name: Copy Google Document
description: Tool to create a copy of an existing Google Document. Use this to duplicate a document, for example, when using an existing document as a template. The copied document will have a default title (e.g., 'Copy of [original title]') if no new title is provided, and will be placed in the user's root Google Drive folder.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title for the new copied document. If not provided, the title will be 'Copy of [original document's title]'.
title.human_parameter_description: The name you want to give to the new document copy. If you don't provide one, it will be automatically labeled as 'Copy of [original document's title]'.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The ID of the Google Document to be copied.
document_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier for the Google Document you wish to copy. This is essential for locating the document in your Google Drive.

include_shared_drives.title: Include Shared Drives
include_shared_drives.description: Whether to support copying documents from shared drives. Defaults to True.
include_shared_drives.human_parameter_description: Enable copying documents from shared drives (team drives) you have access to.

name: Create and Populate Table in Google Doc
description: Creates a table in a Google Document and attempts to populate its cells with the provided text. Table creation and cell population are separate steps, so a failure after creation can leave the table in the document.

input_parameters.title: CreateAndPopulateTableRequest

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: The number of rows in the table. Must be between 1 and 20.

index.title: Index
index.description: The zero-based index where the table will be inserted, in UTF-16 code units. The index must be strictly less than the segment's end index. To insert at the end of a segment, omit this parameter and set 'insertAtEndOfSegment' to true instead.

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: The number of columns in the table. Must be between 1 and 20.

cellData.title: Cell Data
cellData.description: A 2D array (list of lists) containing the text content for each cell. The outer list represents rows, and each inner list represents columns. Must match the dimensions specified by 'rows' and 'columns'. Empty strings are allowed for empty cells.

segmentId.title: Segment Id
segmentId.description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.

documentId.title: Document Id
documentId.description: The ID of the document to update.

insertAtEndOfSegment.title: Insert At End Of Segment
insertAtEndOfSegment.description: If true, inserts the table at the end of the segment (document body, header, or footer specified by segment_id). If false or omitted, and 'index' is not provided, it defaults to inserting at the end of the document body.

input_parameters.description: Request to create a table and populate it with cell data.

name: Create a document
description: Creates a new Google Docs document using the provided title as filename and inserts the initial text at the beginning if non-empty, returning the document's ID and metadata (excluding body content).

text.title: Text
examples: This document outlines the key findings...
text.description: Optional initial text content to insert at the beginning of the new document. If not provided, an empty document will be created. For very large text (over 50,000 characters), the text will be inserted in chunks to avoid API limits.
text.human_parameter_description: The text you want to add to the start of your new document. This helps set the tone or context for what follows. Leave empty to create a blank document.

title.title: Title
title.description: Title for the new document, used as its filename in Google Drive.
title.human_parameter_description: The title you want for your new document. This will be the name it shows up with in Google Drive.

name: Create Document Markdown
description: Creates a new Google Docs document, optionally initializing it with a title and content provided as Markdown text.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title for the new Google Docs document.
title.human_parameter_description: The title of the document you want to create. Please provide a meaningful title to help identify the document later.

file.title: FileUploadable

name.title: Name
name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.title: S3Key
s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.title: Mimetype
mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

file.description: Uploaded image file. The action converts it into a temporary public URL that Google Docs can fetch.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name used to reference the uploaded image from Markdown, for example attachment://diagram or ./diagram.png.

image_assets.title: Image Assets
image_assets.description: Optional uploaded images that Markdown can reference by name. Use Markdown image syntax like ![Alt](attachment://diagram). Public HTTPS image URLs in markdown do not need image_assets.

markdown_text.title: Markdown Text
markdown_text.description: The initial content for the document, formatted as Markdown. Also accepts 'content' as an alias. Supports headings, real Google Docs lists including nested lists, multiple Markdown tables, task-list markers, images via publicly accessible URLs or matching image_assets uploads (max 2KB URL length after resolution; formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF; SVG not supported), blockquotes, code blocks, hyperlinks (e.g., [text](url)), and text formatting (bold, italic, etc.). If empty or omitted, creates document with title only.
markdown_text.human_parameter_description: Enter the content you want in the document, formatted in Markdown. Supports headings, real nested lists, multiple tables, task-list markers, public URL images or matching uploaded image assets, blockquotes, code blocks, hyperlinks [text](url), and text formatting. Optional - leave empty to create a document with just the title.

name: Create Footer
description: Creates a footer in a Google document for the specified type and optional section. If the API reports that a footer already exists, the tool may return the document's existing default footer ID instead.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of footer to create.
type.human_parameter_description: Specify the type of footer you want to create. Choose from various footer styles to best fit your document.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The ID of the document to create the footer in.
document_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the document where you want to add a footer. This ID helps us know which document to work with.

section_break_location.title: Location

index.title: Index
index.description: The zero-based index, in UTF-16 code units, relative to the beginning of the segment.

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.

segmentId.title: Segment Id
segmentId.description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.

section_break_location.description: The location of the SectionBreak immediately preceding the section whose SectionStyle this footer should belong to. If this is unset or refers to the first section break in the document, the footer applies to the document style.
section_break_location.human_parameter_description: Indicate where in the document this footer should apply. This helps to associate the footer with a specific section.

name: Create Footnote
description: Tool to create a new footnote in a Google Document. Use this when you need to add a footnote at a specific location or at the end of the document body.

location.title: Location

index.title: Index
index.description: The zero-based index, in UTF-16 code units. The index is relative to the beginning of the segment specified by segment_id.
index.human_parameter_description: The position in the document where you want to add the footnote. This is based on the text count.

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.
tabId.human_parameter_description: Indicates which tab the footnote is associated with. If not specified, it defaults to the first tab.

segmentId.title: Segment Id
segmentId.description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.
segmentId.human_parameter_description: The identifier of the section where the footnote will be placed. If left empty, it means you're working in the main body of the document.

location.description: Inserts the footnote reference at a specific index in the document. The segmentId within this Location object must be empty as footnotes can only be inserted in the document body.
location.human_parameter_description: Defines the exact spot in the document for the footnote reference. Keep in mind that it can only be placed in the main body.

documentId.title: Document Id
documentId.description: The ID of the document to create the footnote in.
documentId.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier for the document where you want to insert the footnote.

endOfSegmentLocation.title: EndOfSegmentLocation

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.
tabId.human_parameter_description: Specifies the tab for placing the footnote. If not provided, it will default to the first tab.

segmentId.title: Segment Id
segmentId.description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.
segmentId.human_parameter_description: The identifier for the section where the footnote is to be added. Leaving it empty means you're focusing on the document body.

endOfSegmentLocation.description: Inserts the footnote reference at the end of the document body. The segmentId within this EndOfSegmentLocation object must be empty.
endOfSegmentLocation.human_parameter_description: Indicates that you want to add the footnote reference at the end of the document. The segment ID should be blank.

name: Create Header
description: Creates a header in a Google Document, optionally for a specified section, and can add text. For a document-level default header, it may reuse an existing header; text insertion is attempted separately and its success is reported.

input_parameters.title: CreateHeaderRequest

text.title: Text
text.description: Optional text content to add to the header after creation. If provided, the text will be inserted into the header at index 0.
text.human_parameter_description: The text content to add to the header. If not provided, an empty header will be created.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of header to create. Use 'DEFAULT' for the standard document header. Only one DEFAULT header can exist per document; if one already exists, the existing header ID will be returned.
type.human_parameter_description: The type of header to create. Use 'DEFAULT' for a standard header.

documentId.title: Document Id
documentId.description: The ID of the document to create the header in.
documentId.human_parameter_description: Provide the unique identifier of the document where you want to add a header.

sectionBreakLocation.title: Location

index.title: Index
index.description: The zero-based index, in UTF-16 code units.
index.human_parameter_description: The zero-based index, in UTF-16 code units.

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.
tabId.human_parameter_description: The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.

segmentId.title: Segment Id
segmentId.description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.
segmentId.human_parameter_description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.

sectionBreakLocation.description: The location of the SectionBreak which begins the section this header should belong to. Only needed for section-specific headers.
sectionBreakLocation.human_parameter_description: The location of the SectionBreak for section-specific headers.

input_parameters.description:
Request to create a header in a Google Document, optionally with text content.

Accepts flat parameters directly:
- document_id: The ID of the document
- type: The header type (DEFAULT or HEADER_FOOTER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED)
- text: Optional text content to add to the header after creation
- section_break_location: Optional location for section-specific headers

name: Create Named Range
description: Tool to create a new named range in a Google Document. Use this to assign a name to a specific part of the document for easier reference or programmatic manipulation.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name for the new named range. Must be 1-256 characters.
name.human_parameter_description: Choose a meaningful name for the new named range. This name will help you easily refer to this specific section in the document later.

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: Optional. The ID of the document tab containing this range. When omitted, Google Docs applies the request to the first tab.

documentId.title: Document Id
documentId.description: The ID of the document where the named range will be created.
documentId.human_parameter_description: Provide the ID of the document where you want to create the named range. This helps identify the specific document you're working with.

rangeEndIndex.title: Range End Index
rangeEndIndex.description: The zero-based end index of the range.
rangeEndIndex.human_parameter_description: Indicate where the range should end. This index marks the endpoint for the content you want to include in the named range.

rangeSegmentId.title: Range Segment Id
rangeSegmentId.description: Optional. The ID of the header, footer, or footnote. Empty for document body.
rangeSegmentId.human_parameter_description: If needed, provide the ID of a specific segment like a header, footer, or footnote. If you're working with the main body of the document, you can leave this blank.

rangeStartIndex.title: Range Start Index
rangeStartIndex.description: The zero-based start index of the range.
rangeStartIndex.human_parameter_description: Specify the starting point of the range in the document. This index tells the system where to begin including content in the named range.

name: Create Paragraph Bullets
description: Tool to add bullets to paragraphs within a specified range in a Google Document. Use when you need to format a list or a set of paragraphs as bullet points.

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: Optional tab ID to apply to createParagraphBullets.range.tabId. When omitted, Google Docs applies the request to the first tab.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The ID of the document to update.
document_id.human_parameter_description: Please provide the document ID where you want to add bullet points.

createParagraphBullets.title: Create Paragraph Bullets

range.title: Range

tabId.title: Tab Id
tabId.description: The ID of the tab that contains this range. When omitted, Google Docs applies the request to the first tab.

endIndex.title: End Index
endIndex.description: The zero-based end index of the range, exclusive.
endIndex.human_parameter_description: Specify the endpoint of the range in the document, where the bullet formatting will stop.

segmentId.title: Segment Id
segmentId.description: The ID of the header, footer, or footnote that this range is contained in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.
segmentId.human_parameter_description: If applicable, provide the ID of a specific section, like a header or footer, where the bullets should be applied.

startIndex.title: Start Index
startIndex.description: The zero-based start index of the range, inclusive.
startIndex.human_parameter_description: Provide the starting point of the range in the document where you want to apply the bullet formatting.

range.description: The range to apply the bullet preset to.
range.human_parameter_description: The range to apply the bullet preset to.

bulletPreset.title: Bullet Preset
bulletPreset.description: The kinds of bullet glyphs to be used.
bulletPreset.human_parameter_description: Choose the style of bullet points you want to use for the paragraphs.

createParagraphBullets.description: The request body for creating paragraph bullets in the document.

name: Create Document Tab
description: Creates a new tab in a Google Docs document. Tabs allow you to organize document content into separate sections within a single document. Use this action when you need to add a new organizational tab to a document. When a tab is added at a specified index, all subsequent tabs' indexes are automatically incremented.

input_parameters.title: CreateTabRequest

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The unique identifier of the Google Docs document where the tab will be created. This ID can be found in the document's URL.

tab_properties.title: TabProperties

index.title: Index
index.description: The zero-based position where the tab should be inserted within its parent tab group. If not specified, the tab is added at the end. When a tab is added at a given index, all subsequent tabs' indexes are incremented.

title.title: Title
title.description: The user-visible title/name of the tab. If not specified, Google Docs will generate a default title.

parentTabId.title: Parent Tab Id
parentTabId.description: The ID of the parent tab under which this tab should be created. Leave empty or omit to create a root-level tab. Must be a valid tab ID from the document.

tab_properties.description: Properties of a tab to be created.

input_parameters.description: Request model for creating a new tab in a Google Document.
